k-sym-NЕIL.title: Neil the Lemur plushie coins
k-sym-NЕIL.sourceSays: Posts say Neil, a lemur at the San Francisco Zoo, went viral carrying a plushie, and some accounts call him the next Punch; several copycat Neil coins are circulating.
k-sym-NЕIL.reason: Posts of Nov 13-16 describe the zoo lemur and plushie story (an RT post Nov 13); the coin pools opened hours ago, after the story. Duplicate Neil tickers exist and the viral claim is unverified.
